dataset_title: 45th BCS preliminary: selected mathematics and reasoning questions
format: UTF-8 JSON; top-level arrays in question and answer datasets
schema_reference: User-supplied demo ZIP, files.json/please_read.docx and populated sample JSON files

field_meanings.family_id: Q + original three-digit printed question number. IDs are scoped to this source; use (source_id, family_id) as the cross-PDF key.
field_meanings.correct_answer: The supplied PDF's printed key, represented using the corresponding option string. Not an independently substituted answer. Questionable keys are quarantined.
field_meanings.in_scope: Taxonomy eligibility, not a reliability or training-readiness flag. Even quarantined questions remain in_scope=true.
field_meanings.solution_steps: Model-generated teaching solution, not a solution extracted from the PDF; withheld for blocking cases.
field_meanings.possible_mistakes: Synthetic teaching examples of possible errors, not observed student mistakes or source-authored explanations.
field_meanings.diverges_at_step: 1-based index of the first erroneous step in that mistake's own reasoning_steps list, not an index into the correct solution.
field_meanings.target_completion_time: Estimated seconds expressed as a string, matching the sample convention.

image_handling.representation: Markdown image references inside existing string fields; no new keys are added to the sample question schema.
image_handling.path_base: Paths resolve relative to this dataset folder. Keep assets/ beside the JSON files.
image_handling.leakage_warning: Do not use audit_assets/ as model question inputs; those crops intentionally include printed answers for source review.
image_handling.text_only_loading: Q181, Q183, and Q187 in the included data require image-aware loading. Q186 is an image-dependent quarantined record.

normalization_policy: Transcribe Bengali from the rendered pages because the embedded text has broken glyph mappings; no OCR used.
Retain original option order, Bengali/Latin digit choices, anomalous distractors, and missing content.
Represent mathematical fractions, superscripts, and base indices with LaTeX where appropriate; normalize only spacing/line wraps and typography, not values or operators.
The ambiguous baseline p2/q2 and x2 text in Q166/Q175 is retained and its interpretation is declared in the model-generated solution.
Do not add invented verbal stems to diagram-only questions.
